specialRules.ruleFull: The warband may hire the same hired swords as a Human Mercenary warband.
The warband may choose to rout after one casualty fewer than normal.
Warriors within 6" of the Hatamoto may use his Leadership when taking any Leadership test.
The Hatamoto has the Ride skill of the Blazing Saddles rules.

fighters.name: Vim-To Mage
fighters.equipment: A walking staff (a club) and a dagger only; he may never have any other equipment.

specialRules.ruleFull: The Vim-To Mage may have only a walking staff (a club) and a dagger, never any other equipment.
The Vim-To Mage is a wizard and casts Vim-Toist Magic (Arabian Elemental Magic). He starts with one spell from it.

The Shinobi is set up after the opposing warband, anywhere on the table out of its sight and more than 12" from every enemy model. If both sides have infiltrators, each rolls a D6 and the lowest sets up first.
The Shinobi may never become the warband's leader.
A Retainer has the Ride skill of the Blazing Saddles rules.
An Ashigaru may wield a spear in both hands; it then gains the Parry rule.
An Onnabushi inside a building or ruin causes fear. Agree which terrain counts as buildings or ruins before the battle.

specialSkillsList.name: Death before Dishonor
specialSkillsList.description: When a close combat attack would remove this model from the battlefield, it first makes a single close combat attack as normal.

specialSkillsList.name: Night Fighter
specialSkillsList.description: Shinobi only. The model may run and still stay hidden, as the hiding rules allow.

specialSkillsList.name: Iaijutsu
specialSkillsList.description: When the model is charged it gains +1 Attack, used only against the charger, which strikes first. Charged by two or more at once, it still gains only +1 Attack. This attack is at the model's Strength with no other modifiers.

specialSkillsList.name: Last Stand
specialSkillsList.description: The model may re-roll an All Alone test. At the start of its turn, if it is 6" away from friendly models, it may take +1 WS or +1 BS until the start of its next turn.

specialSkillsList.name: Tea Ceremony
specialSkillsList.description: After a battle in which this Hero survived and wasn't taken out of action, he may skip searching for rare items and spend 10 gc to choose another Hero and roll a D6: on a 3+ that Hero gains 1 experience.

specialSkillsList.name: Blessed by the Kami
specialSkillsList.description: After a game in which this Hero was taken out of action, he may re-roll his roll on the Heroes Serious Injury chart once. The second roll stands, even if it is worse.

rules.name: Concussion
rules.text: A roll of 2-4 on the injury table is a Stunned result.

flags.what: A Nippon warband needs at least 3 models: our templates hold no minimum, so it is not imported.
No maximum profile is printed, so every warrior takes our Human race.

Page 2 is a scan with no text layer, read from the page image: the skill chart (Hatamoto all six; Vim-To Mage Academic, Speed, Special; Shinobi Combat, Shooting, Speed, Special; Retainer Combat, Shooting, Strength, Special) and the special skills.

The special skills are a new group, Nipponese Expedition. Blessed by the Kami (re-roll the Heroes Serious Injury roll once, the second result stands) does what our Extra Tough does, under another name, so it is kept apart (William, 6 Nov 2026: "sep").

Four stubs, their rules on p3, the Kanabo carrying its own (Common, 15 gc; Close Combat, As user +1, Two-Handed and Concussion). It is 15 gc like our Double-handed weapon, but a different weapon and not a second name for it: the Nippon lists sell both, and ours is As user +2 and always strikes last (William, 11 Nov 2026: one entry for a weapon we hold under another name, which this is not). The other three are Sashimono (Common, 15 gc; re-roll Leadership tests other than Rout), Horo (Rare 6, 10 gc; +1 armour save against shooting while mounted) and Kusarigama (Rare 8, 20 gc; Two-Handed, Cannot be parried, Chain Strike). The text layer puts the Kanabo's special rules under the Horo.
The Sashimono is 15 gc on the Warrior and Noble lists and 20 gc on the Warrior Monk list: each as printed. The Katana links our Dragon Sword by its tag (the PDF gives it no rules).
The Noble list is the Warrior list plus its own lines, so it repeats the Warrior list's lines. The Ashigaru and Onnabushi buy from the Warrior list ("the Nippon equipment list").
The Vim-To Mage buys from no list: his Tenants of the Order allow only a walking staff (a club) and a dagger, at no price given. His Vim-Toist Magic is our Arabian Elemental Magic, as the PDF says.
No group sizes are printed: left open.
